blurb: Fast Friday Drags & Burnout Box is your weekend kickoff for wide-open drag racing at Famoso! From fire-breathing dragsters to your trusty daily driver, everyone’s welcome for an evening of Test N Tune action. Friday night features racing under the lights and the fan-favorite Burnout Box. Tech Cards are $60, and spectator admission is $20.
